name: Point Cloud Projection with Depth Sorting
definition: Renders a voxelized point cloud to a 2D image by quantizing 3D coordinates, applying user-controlled panning, sorting by depth, and resolving overlaps.
summary: Point Cloud Projection with Depth Sorting renders voxelized point clouds into 2D images by quantizing coordinates and resolving overlaps via depth comparison to enable simultaneous reference and distorted content comparison.
